description: Titus's battle actions and how each one is made inside Remake's battle system (input, trigger, effect, sounds).

columns.name: Name shown to the player.
columns.input: How the player triggers it (Remake's default PC/pad bindings).
columns.effect: What it does, in game terms.
columns.ff7r_route: How it is built in FF7R (native ability reused, damage source spawned, status applied...).

rows.name: Melee combo
rows.effect: Remake's real-time combo with the equipped SM2 melee weapon's damage/stagger multipliers; each hit wins back contested health.
rows.ff7r_route: ?Cloud's native combo kept; damage scaled via OnGiveDamage-driven bonus damage source

rows.name: Parry → Gun Strike
rows.input: Guard just before an enemy hit lands
rows.effect: Perfect parry negates the hit, then Titus fires his gun point-blank into the attacker for heavy stagger.
rows.ff7r_route: ?Remake's just-guard (OnGiveDamage InJustGuard / Punisher counter) + spawned gun damage source on the attacker

rows.name: Execution
rows.input: Attack + Guard together near a staggered enemy
rows.effect: Brutal finisher dealing big damage and refilling one armour plate (two with the Power Fist). Titus's battle cry plays.
rows.ff7r_route: ?IsBurst on target, spawned high-damage source, armour refill in survival logic

rows.name: Fire gun
rows.input: Hold the ranged button (Remake's ability/Shift slot, rebound for Titus)
rows.effect: Fires the equipped SM2 gun at the locked target at its fire rate; reload when empty.
rows.ff7r_route: ?CreateDamageSource with an existing FF7R projectile id and overridden damage

rows.name: Frag Grenade
rows.ff7r_route: ?command menu entry reusing an existing ability slot; explosion damage source

rows.name: Krak Grenade
rows.ff7r_route: ?command menu entry reusing an existing ability slot; explosion damage source

rows.name: Fury (Fureur)
rows.input: Limit menu when the Limit gauge is full
rows.effect: For 20 s Titus hits 50% harder, every hit heals and contested health never decays; ends with a roar.
rows.ff7r_route: ?Cloud's Limit Break entry renamed; on activation apply attack-up + regen via survival logic
